question: Does increasing shared reward mixing in 12-agent Tribal Village reduce MAPPO shared-encoder role geometry and behavioral diversity?

canonical_scenario.policy: single shared MAPPO policy, no role input and no agent-specific parameters

role_shaping_before_mixing.explorer: 0.5 if no gold or altar is visible

primary_rerun.reporting_unit: mean and std across independent training seeds
primary_rerun.eval_trials_role: estimate each seed's final metrics, not the table-level uncertainty

canonical_metrics.effrank_per_agent: effective rank over flattened eval embeddings [eval_steps * agents, embedding_dim], divided by n_agents
canonical_metrics.d_act_ordered_kl: mean ordered off-diagonal KL over n_agents * (n_agents - 1) pairs
canonical_metrics.d_act_js: offline robustness check using unordered Jensen-Shannon divergence
canonical_metrics.role_probe_acc: 3-way fixed-role probe for labels agent_id % 3; chance is 1/3

mechanism_checks.name: no_role_shaping
mechanism_checks.purpose: separate reward-mixing effects from hand-designed role-shaping rewards

mechanism_checks.name: separate_encoders
mechanism_checks.purpose: test whether shared-encoder gradient sharing is the proximate mechanism

non_canonical_streams.reason: later MettaGrid arena reward-ablation stream uses binary top/bottom return probes, not the fixed 3-way Tribal role probe
